Bundled offline OCR components

The Apache License is included in this directory as LICENSE. The minified
bundle notices are provided in the corresponding .LICENSE.txt files.

English trained data: @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0 (package metadata lists MIT);
the model is distributed for use with the open-source Tesseract project.
No OCR resource is fetched from a third-party server by this application.

French, Spanish and Italian trained data: tessdata_fast, pinned upstream commit
87416418657359cb625c412a48b6e1d6d41c29bd, Apache License 2.0. The repository
license is included as LICENSE. Models are gzipped for local loading.
Source: https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast
